chapter.title: Create: Electric Power
chapter.subtitle: Start with the Rolling Mill and follow the chain

quests.title: Rolling Mill
quests.subtitle: Press sheets and rods
description: The Rolling Mill presses ingots into rods, wires, and sheets. It is the foundation of Create's electric power.
Next: an Electric Motor to turn FE into rotational power.

quests.title: Electric Motor
quests.subtitle: FE into rotation
description: An Electric Motor converts Forge Energy (FE) into rotational power, bridging electricity and Create.
Next: an Alternator to do the reverse.

quests.title: Alternator
quests.subtitle: Rotation into FE
description: An Alternator converts rotational power into FE, letting your Create machines generate electricity.
Next: a Connector to attach wires.

quests.title: Connector
quests.subtitle: Attach wires to machines
description: Connectors attach Copper Wires to machines, letting electricity flow between them.
Next: Copper Wire to carry that power.

quests.title: Copper Wire
quests.subtitle: Carry electricity
description: Copper Wire carries FE between Connectors. Roll copper into wire at the Rolling Mill.
Next: Electrum Ingots for a new material tier.

quests.title: Electrum Ingot
quests.subtitle: New material tier
description: Electrum (gold + silver) adds a new material tier that integrates with Mekanism ore processing.
Next: a Capacitor to store electrical charge.

quests.title: Capacitor
quests.subtitle: Store electrical charge
description: A Capacitor stores charge and boosts the power of nearby electric machines.
Next: an Accumulator for bulk FE storage.

quests.title: Accumulator
quests.subtitle: Bulk FE storage
description: An Accumulator stores large amounts of FE, buffering your electric power grid.
This completes the Electric Power chapter.

quests.title: Redstone Relay
quests.subtitle: Wireless redstone over power lines
description: A Redstone Relay sends redstone signals over your electric power lines.

quests.title: Tesla Coil
quests.subtitle: Wireless power
description: A Tesla Coil transmits FE wirelessly over short distances.
